blocks.text: HANGS Construction Services LLC
2025 corporate tax questionnaire
Demonstration document. Not for filing or payment.
Tax year: 2025
Answered by: Morgan Lee, Controller
Answered on: 2026-02-27

rows: Accrual. Contract revenue by the percentage-of-completion method for books and tax, as in prior years.
Commercial and institutional building construction, code 236220.
Celeste Whitford 60% and Riley Tanaka 40%, both U.S. individuals. No change in 2025.

President Celeste Whitford: salary $150,000.00 and a $30,000.00 year-end bonus accrued December 31, 2025 and paid January 9, 2026. Vice President Riley Tanaka: salary $110,000.00. The members' written consent approving 2025 compensation was prepared December 18, 2025 and has not been signed.
Loans or advances to or from owners or related companies

On June 30, 2025 HANGS advanced $120,000.00 to Juniper Ridge Holdings LLC, owned by our Vice President, Riley Tanaka, for site work on its parcel. No note was signed and no interest is charged. We expect it to be repaid when the parcel is refinanced.
Fines or penalties paid to a government
Yes. A $4,250.00 Labor and Industries citation penalty, paid July 14, 2025, recorded in taxes and licenses.
Business meals with clients, subcontractors and crews, and one purchase of stadium suite tickets for the owner's representatives ($1,840.00) with no meal.
Four cash gifts to section 501(c)(3) organizations, $36,000.00 in all, each acknowledged in writing. No carryover from 2024.

Four additions and no disposals. The trailer was ordered on purchase order PO-24-117 signed December 18, 2024 and delivered January 27, 2025; the excavator purchase agreement was signed February 24, 2025. No election out of the special depreciation allowance and no section 179 election.

Four 2025 payments through EFTPS, $48,300.00 in all, equal to the 2024 tax. The September payment was reduced to $5,000.00 while retainage on the Pier 9 Tech Center job was outstanding; the shortfall was made up on December 15. No 2024 overpayment was credited.
$60,000.00 paid December 19, 2025, 60% and 40%. Forms 1099-DIV issued January 2026.
No receivable was written off in 2025. The allowance was increased to $6,180.00 under the credit policy.
Yes, required and filed for 2025 payments in January 2026.

preview.subject: HANGS Construction Services 2025 Form 1120 year-end records
preview.body:
Hi,

Attached are our final adjusted trial balance at December 31, 2025, the general ledger detail for the accounts you asked about and the fixed asset register with book and tax depreciation. The prior-year return summary, the questionnaire, the estimated tax log and the members' consent are in the shared folder. Please prepare the 2025 Form 1120 for us to review.

A few things you will want to look at:

- Our September estimated payment was only $5,000.00 because the Pier 9 Tech Center retainage came in late. We caught up on December 15.
- The $120,000.00 we advanced to Juniper Ridge Holdings LLC in June has no note yet. Let us know what you need.
- The members' consent for 2025 officer pay, including the President's $30,000.00 bonus, still has to be signed. The bonus was paid January 9.
- The Labor and Industries penalty from July is in taxes and licenses.
- The depreciation software took 100% bonus on all four 2025 additions.

Thanks,
Morgan Lee
Controller, HANGS Construction Services LLC

messages.subject: HANGS Construction Services 2025 Form 1120 year-end records
messages.body:
Hi,

Attached are our final adjusted trial balance at December 31, 2025, the general ledger detail for the accounts you asked about and the fixed asset register with book and tax depreciation. The prior-year return summary, the questionnaire, the estimated tax log and the members' consent are in the shared folder. Please prepare the 2025 Form 1120 for us to review.

A few things you will want to look at:

- Our September estimated payment was only $5,000.00 because the Pier 9 Tech Center retainage came in late. We caught up on December 15.
- The $120,000.00 we advanced to Juniper Ridge Holdings LLC in June has no note yet. Let us know what you need.
- The members' consent for 2025 officer pay, including the President's $30,000.00 bonus, still has to be signed. The bonus was paid January 9.
- The Labor and Industries penalty from July is in taxes and licenses.
- The depreciation software took 100% bonus on all four 2025 additions.

Thanks,
Morgan Lee
Controller, HANGS Construction Services LLC

passages.q: Which 2025 Form 1120 lines and Schedule M-1 lines does the draft fill?
passages.a: 31 Total tax (Schedule J, line 12) ... 33 Total payments, credits, and section 1062 applicable net tax liability (Schedule J, line 23) ... 34 Estimated tax penalty. See instructions. Check if Form 2220 is attached ... Schedule M-1 ... 5 Expenses recorded on books this year not deducted on this return (itemize): a Depreciation ... b Charitable contributions ... c Travel and entertainment ... 8 Deductions on this return not charged against book income this year (itemize): a Depreciation

sources.title: Form 2220 (2025), Underpayment of Estimated Tax by Corporations

passages.q: What underpayment rate applies to the September to December 2025 period?
passages.a: Number of days on line 20 after 6/30/2025 and before 10/1/2025 ... x 7% (0.07) ... Number of days on line 20 after 9/30/2025 and before 1/1/2026 ... x 7% (0.07)

sources.title: Instructions for Form 1120 (2025), U.S. Corporation Income Tax Return

passages.q: What is the 2025 corporate income tax rate?
passages.a: Line 1a. Income tax. Multiply taxable income (page 1, line 30) by 21% (0.21). Enter this amount on line 1a.

passages.q: When is the 2025 calendar-year return due?
passages.a: Generally, a corporation must file its income tax return by the 15th day of the 4th month after the end of its tax year.

passages.q: Must HANGS complete Schedules L, M-1 and M-2, and is Schedule M-3 needed instead?
passages.a: Corporations with total receipts (page 1, line 1a plus lines 4 through 10) and total assets at the end of the tax year less than $250,000 are not required to complete Schedules L, M-1, and M-2 ... Corporations with total assets nonconsolidated ... of $10 million or more on the last day of the tax year must file Schedule M-3 (Form 1120) instead of Schedule M-1.

sources.title: Instructions for Form 2220 (2025), Underpayment of Estimated Tax by Corporations

passages.q: What did HANGS have to pay in each 2025 installment?
passages.a: Generally, a corporation is subject to the penalty if it did not timely pay at least the smaller of: the tax shown on its 2025 return, or the tax shown on its 2024 return (if it filed a 2024 return showing at least some amount of tax and the return was for a full 12 months). ... A large corporation is a corporation ... that had ... taxable income ... of $1 million or more for any of the 3 tax years immediately preceding the 2025 tax year ... The corporation is generally required to enter the 15th day of the 4th ... 6th, 9th, and 12th months of its tax year.

passages.q: How is the penalty for the short September installment figured?
passages.a: The period of underpayment generally runs from the installment due date to the earlier of the date the underpayment is actually paid or the 15th day of the 4th month after the close of the tax year. ... A payment of estimated tax is applied against unpaid required installments in the order in which installments are required to be paid, regardless of the installment to which the payment pertains.

sources.title: Instructions for Form 4562 (2025), Depreciation and Amortization

passages.q: What special depreciation allowance applies to the excavator, the crew 3 truck and the tablets acquired in 2025?
passages.a: P.L. 119-21, commonly known as the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, reinstated the 100% special depreciation allowance for certain qualified property acquired and placed in service after January 19, 2025 ... However, you can elect to take a 40% special depreciation allowance ... during first tax year ending after January 19, 2025, instead of taking the 100% special depreciation allowance.

passages.q: What allowance applies to the trailer ordered in December 2024 and delivered in January 2025?
passages.a: Unless you elect out, you must take a 40% special depreciation allowance for certain qualified property acquired after September 27, 2017, and placed in service after December 31, 2024, and before January 1, 2026 (other than certain property with a long production period and certain aircraft).

passages.q: What recovery period and rates apply to the construction equipment, vehicles and computers?
passages.a: 5-year property. Automobiles, taxis, buses, helicopters, and trucks. ... Construction: Includes assets used in construction by general building, special trade, heavy, and marine construction contractors ... Table A-1. 3-, 5-, 7-, 10-, 15-, and 20-year property, half-year convention ... 5-year: 20.00% 32.00 19.20 11.52 11.52 5.76

passages.a: (a) Treatment of gift loans and demand loans (1) In general. For purposes of this title, in the case of any below-market loan to which this section applies and which is a gift loan or a demand loan, the forgone interest shall be treated as ... (C) Corporation-shareholder loans. Any below-market loan directly or indirectly between a corporation and any shareholder of such corporation.
